title: Return, iv
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Thursday. The pup's first Lanes. Not the Dog Night — that's November. Just the alley, in daylight, on the way somewhere else. The pup pulls toward the dumpster like he knows. Wood doesn't let him. Not yet.

panels.composition: The alley mouth behind the Lanes, day. WOOD walking past it, not into it. BARNABY II on the leash, pulling toward it.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man walking past an alley mouth behind a bowling alley by day while a small three-legged puppy on a leash pulls toward it

panels.composition: The leash taut. The pup's whole body pointed at the alley.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a taut leash and a small puppy's body straining toward an alley, no words

panels.composition: Wood looking down the alley. The dumpster. The box behind it, gray, still there from December.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man looking down an alley at a dumpster with a collapsed gray cardboard box behind it, no words

panels.composition: Wood walking on. The pup following, looking back. The sign above with the S dark. November's a ways off.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man walking on past an alley with a small three-legged puppy following and looking back, a bowling-alley sign above with one letter dark, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The pup pulls toward the dumpster. Not yet.
